title: Delivery-event replay
product_shape: Go event-processing service with embedded storage

visible_input.change_request: Add a bounded command that replays selected dead-letter delivery events.
visible_input.expected_toolchain: current declared Go toolchain and go test

ground_truth_observations: handlers run concurrently with bounded workers
event IDs are deduplicated in embedded storage
health and metrics endpoints expose queue state
Git history records a shutdown race
reviewable_inferences: shutdown cancellation is an impacted operational boundary
traps: claiming operational safety from unit tests alone

target_outcome: A verified bounded replay command with authorization, cancellation, deduplication, and audit evidence.
